title: The Warmest Fur on Earth Belongs to an Animal With No Blubber

scenes.text: The warmest fur on Earth belongs to an animal with no blubber.
Sea otters are the only marine mammals with no blubber at all.
So they survive freezing water on fur alone, more than a million fibers per square inch.
A human head has about a hundred thousand hairs in total.
That dense fur traps a layer of air against the skin, so the cold water never touches it.
No blubber. Just a million hairs per square inch.

description:
The warmest fur on Earth belongs to an animal with no blubber.
A sea otter packs about a million fibers into every square inch.
Could you survive in that water?
first_comment: Would you trade your coat for that fur? Tell us.
